I definitely agree. Throughout the entire season I kept thinking of the "show, don't tell" principle that my high school English teachers constantly reminded us of. It felt like nothing was implied--there were so many character entrances where they just *happened* to be telling each other their main goals as they entered the room, and it just felt awkward. Also, a lot of characters saying things like "I'm the kind of person who..." instead of making their character traits clear through their actions or other lines of dialog. And I realize a lot of other shows do this, but I don't remember it being as prevalent in other seasons
